ai.optOutMethod: Enterprise account controls, contractual settings, or support requests for eligible workflows.
ai.retentionPeriod: Prompts, outputs, and related logs are retained only for the time reasonably necessary for service delivery, abuse prevention, quality review, and product improvement under the applicable workflow.
ai.sensitiveDataRestrictions: Users should avoid submitting sensitive data unless explicitly required by the service, contractually agreed, and protected by stronger controls.
ai.securityControls: Minimization, access controls, audit logs, segmented environments, and reasonable monitoring are applied to prompts, outputs, and AI-related operational data.
ai.transparencyNotes: We review high-risk or newly introduced AI features before rollout and may provide feature-specific notices where the workflow requires more detailed disclosure.
